templates.why_chosen: Two components (Controller, GPU Server) sit under one 'Serverless Cluster' label beside a separate 'LLM Inference' detail box, with three named contribution boxes along the bottom pointing dashed arrows up into the parts they optimize.
templates.what_to_learn: Label a background sub-system with one umbrella name (here 'Serverless Cluster') so a detail panel can sit beside it without seeming detached, and place each contribution as its own small box below with a dashed arrow pointing up into the exact component it modifies; enlarge label text well past this figure's 4.5-5.5pt, a listed weakness.
